# Pinned web map assets

Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD 2-Clause, `LEAFLET-LICENSE`) and Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3 (MIT, `MARKERCLUSTER-LICENSE`) are vendored from their published unpkg distributions. The same versions were already used by the Phase 2 map.

`bundled.ts` is generated by `python apps/mobile/scripts/bundle-map-assets.py` from the `.txt` originals. This puts JavaScript/CSS inside the sandboxed map iframe, so loading the interactive markers and clusters no longer requires an external script CDN. Map tiles still require OpenStreetMap network access; the existing tile-failure state stays visible and the destination list still works.

Do not remove map/source attribution. Destination coordinates retain the original OSM provenance. Map tiles are not bundled or prefetched.
